theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have h₁ : relation d e := h.1
  have h₂ : relation e f := h.2
  have h₃ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₄ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j) := (hrelation d e).mp h₁ |>.2 i
    have h₅ : digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j) = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num]
      calc
        ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then e j else d j) * 10 ^ j.1
          = ∑ j : Fin 9, (d j + (if j = i then e j - d j else 0)) * 10 ^ j.1 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h] <;> ring
          _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (d j * 10 ^ j.1 + (if j = i then e j - d j else 0) * 10 ^ j.1) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            ring
          _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, d j * 10 ^ j.1 + ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then e j - d j else 0) * 10 ^ j.1 := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          _ = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
            simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte, hdigits_to_num]
    rw [h₅] at h₄
    exact h₄
  have h₄ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₅ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then f j else e j) := (hrelation e f).mp h₂ |>.2 i
    have h₆ : digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then f j else e j) = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num]
      calc
        ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then f j else e j) * 10 ^ j.1
          = ∑ j : Fin 9, (e j + (if j = i then f j - e j else 0)) * 10 ^ j.1 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h] <;> ring
          _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (e j * 10 ^ j.1 + (if j = i then f j - e j else 0) * 10 ^ j.1) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            ring
          _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, e j * 10 ^ j.1 + ∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then f j - e j else 0) * 10 ^ j.1 := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          _ = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
            simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte, hdigits_to_num]
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    exact h₅
  have h₅ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    have h₆ : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) := by
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro i _
      exact h₃ i
    have h₇ : ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) = 9 * digits_to_num d + ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have h₈ : ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 = digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d := by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num]
      calc
        ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 = ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i * 10 ^ i.1 - d i * 10 ^ i.1) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 9, e i * 10 ^ i.1 - ∑ i : Fin 9, d i * 10 ^ i.1 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d := by
          simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [h₇, h₈] at h₆
    have h₉ : 8 * digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e = (digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e) + 7 * digits_to_num d := by ring
    rw [h₉] at h₆
    have h₁₀ : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := by use digits_to_num d
    have h₁₁ : (digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e) = (8 * digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e) - 7 * digits_to_num d := by ring
    rw [h₁₁]
    exact dvd_sub h₆ h₁₀
  have h₆ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num f := by
    have h₇ : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1) := by
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro i _
      exact h₄ i
    have h₈ : ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1) = 9 * digits_to_num e + ∑ i : Fin 9, (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have h₉ : ∑ i : Fin 9, (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 = digits_to_num f - digits_to_num e := by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num]
      calc
        ∑ i : Fin 9, (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 = ∑ i : Fin 9, (f i * 10 ^ i.1 - e i * 10 ^ i.1) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 9, f i * 10 ^ i.1 - ∑ i : Fin 9, e i * 10 ^ i.1 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num f - digits_to_num e := by
          simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [h₈, h₉] at h₇
    have h₁₀ : 8 * digits_to_num e + digits_to_num f = (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num f) + 7 * digits_to_num e := by ring
    rw [h₁₀] at h₇
    have h₁₁ : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num e := by use digits_to_num e
    have h₁₂ : (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num f) = (8 * digits_to_num e + digits_to_num f) - 7 * digits_to_num e := by ring
    rw [h₁₂]
    exact dvd_sub h₇ h₁₁
  have h₇ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₈ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := h₃ i
    have h₉ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := h₄ i
    have h₁₂ : 7 ∣ (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) + (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1) := by
      exact dvd_add h₈ h₉
    have h₁₃ : (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) + (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1) = (digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e) + (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by ring
    rw [h₁₃] at h₁₂
    have h₁₄ : 7 ∣ (digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e) + (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := h₁₂
    have h₁₅ : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      have h₁₆ : (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 = ((digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e) + (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) - (digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e) := by ring
      rw [h₁₆]
      exact dvd_sub h₁₄ h₅
    exact h₁₅
  have h₈ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ f i - d i := by
    intro i
    have h₉ : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := h₇ i
    have h₁₀ : ¬(7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
      intro h
      have h₁₁ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ (10 : ℕ) ^ i.1 := by
        norm_cast at h ⊢
        exact h
      have h₁₂ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow (by decide) h₁₁
      norm_num at h₁₂
    have h₁₁ : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (f i - d i) ∨ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
      apply (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)).dvd_mul.mp
      exact h₉
    cases h₁₁ with
    | inl h₁₁ => exact h₁₁
    | inr h₁₁ => exfalso; exact h₁₀ h₁₁
  intro i
  exact h₈ i
